title: Carryover Drafting: Recycling Rejected States for Speculative Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.14717v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by verifying multiple drafted tokens in parallel, allowing a single target forward pass to accept several tokens. By construction, verification computes representations for both accepted and rejected tokens. Yet, conventional drafters retain only the representations of accepted tokens, leaving the substantial verifier computation spent on rejected tokens effectively wasted. We find that these discarded hidden states generated during target forward retain useful information about future tokens that can improve subsequent drafts. However, realizing this opportunity poses two distinct challenges. At inference, recycling overhead can increase drafting latency, diminishing the speedup gained from increased acceptance length. translated_title: 延续式草稿生成：为推测解码回收利用被拒绝的状态
translated_abstract: 推测解码通过并行验证多个草稿token来加速大语言模型推理，使单次目标模型前向传播能够接受多个token。按照其构造方式，验证过程会同时计算被接受和被拒绝token的表示。然而，传统的草稿模型只保留被接受token的表示，而在被拒绝token上花费的大量验证器计算实际上被浪费了。我们发现，目标模型前向传播过程中产生的这些被丢弃的隐藏状态保留了关于未来token的有用信息，可以用来改进后续的草稿生成。然而，要实现这一机会面临两个不同的挑战。在推理阶段，回收利用的开销可能会增加草稿生成的延迟，从而削弱接受长度增加所带来的加速效果。在训练阶段，标准的并行草稿模型训练无法产生与推理阶段一致的被拒绝状态，而通过顺序滚动（rollout）来获取这些状态则会牺牲并（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出Carryover Drafting方法，通过回收利用推测解码验证阶段中被拒绝token的隐藏状态所蕴含的未来token信息来改进后续草稿生成，从而进一步提升LLM推理加速效果。
